description: This file contains the implementation of big number division functions used in cryptographic operations, including a primary division function BN_div and a modulo function BN_mod, along with related auxiliary code.

methods.name: int BN_div(BIGNUM * dv,BIGNUM * rm,const BIGNUM * num,const BIGNUM * divisor,BN_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Performs division of big numbers, computing quotient and optionally remainder.

methods.name: int BN_mod(BIGNUM * rem,const BIGNUM * m,const BIGNUM * d,BN_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Computes the modulus (remainder) of division of one big number by another.

ctags.name: BN_div

ctags.signature: (BIGNUM * dv,BIGNUM * rm,const BIGNUM * num,const BIGNUM * divisor,BN_CTX * ctx)

ctags.name: BN_mod
ctags.pattern: /^int BN_mod(BIGNUM *rem, const BIGNUM *m, const BIGNUM *d, BN_CTX *ctx)$/
